description.zh: 多表对齐、去重并保留清洗日志
description.en: Align and deduplicate sheets with an audit log

template.zh: 请清洗并合并 <项目数据文件>，按 <主键与列映射> 保留冲突、缺失和重复记录的清洗日志。
template.en: Clean and merge <Project data files> using <Keys and column mappings>, preserving an audit log.

description.zh: 统一口径、行级结论与复投建议
description.en: Metric definitions, row decisions, and retest recommendations

template.zh: 请根据 <项目计划单与效果表> 只按 <唯一主键> 精确匹配；自动读取口径 Sheet，输出清洗底表、分组、结论、口径、人工确认和日志到最终 Excel。若我明确要求阅读版报告，再基于同一份清洗结果追加 HTML，不要默认双交付；只登记终稿。
template.en: Exact-match <Project plan and effect sheets> by <Unique key>, read the method sheet, and create a final workbook with cleaned data, groups, conclusions, definitions, manual review, and log. Add an HTML reading report from the same cleaned results only when explicitly requested; do not default to dual delivery.

description.zh: 周环比、内容×人群和搜索词×内容矩阵

template.zh: 请用 <本周与上周投放明细> 生成内容×人群、搜索词×内容矩阵，并基于 <内容切角标签> 输出有来源的相关性观察。
template.en: Use <Current and prior week delivery data> to build content-audience and search-content matrices with evidence-based observations.

en: Current and prior week delivery data

description.zh: 目录、逐页建议、缺数与可用初稿
description.en: Outline, page guidance, gaps, and usable draft

template.zh: 请根据 <项目 Brief、执行记录、数据与反馈> 生成八维项目复盘，输出目录、逐页建议、缺失数据和可直接使用的初稿；参考 <历史复盘/模板>。
template.en: Build an eight-dimension review from <Brief, execution, data, and feedback>, using <Historical review/template> when provided.

zh: 项目 Brief、执行记录、数据与反馈

description.zh: 核查来源、口径、结论和缺失项
description.en: Audit sources, metrics, conclusions, and gaps

template.zh: 请终检 <复盘报告与源数据>，逐项核查数据来源、公式口径、相关性/因果措辞和缺失项，输出问题清单。
template.en: Audit <Review report and source data> for provenance, metric definitions, causal wording, and missing items.
